name: eitri-shopping-template-vtex-deco-typecheck
description: Root-only devDependency so `npx tsc` (and CI) resolve to the real TypeScript compiler instead of npm's unrelated `tsc` decoy package. Each app still builds through Eitri's own toolchain — this package.json exists solely for `tsc --noEmit` type-checking across the workspace tsconfig.json.
